# hosttracker_account (Data Source)

The account the configured token belongs to: its package, its limits, and what is left of its API quota. Reading it needs a token carrying the `account:read` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hosttracker_account" "current" {}

output "package" {
  value = data.hosttracker_account.current.package.name
}

# What is left of the API quota for the configured token.
output "api_calls_remaining" {
  value = data.hosttracker_account.current.quota.remaining
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The account id.
- `language` (String) The account's interface language.
- `limits` (Attributes) The bounds the account's writes and reads are held to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--limits))
- `login` (String) The account's login, which is its email address.
- `overlimits` (List of String) Which account-level overlimit bits are set: `task`, `contact`, `report`, `maintenance`. Empty when the account is within its package.
- `package` (Attributes) The account's package. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--package))
- `quota` (Attributes) What is left of the API quota for the configured token. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--quota))
- `timezone` (String) The account's time zone, as an IANA id.

<a id="nestedatt--limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `limits`

Read-Only:

- `alert_delays` (List of Number) The alert-delay ladder, in minutes.
- `default_limit` (Number) The page size a collection read uses when it names none.
- `intervals` (List of Number) The check intervals this package sells, in seconds.
- `max_bulk_items` (Number) Items one bulk create may carry.
- `max_bulk_selection` (Number) Monitors one bulk update or delete may target.
- `max_inline_contacts` (Number) Inline contacts a single monitor create may declare.
- `max_limit` (Number) The largest page size any collection read accepts.


<a id="nestedatt--package"></a>
### Nested Schema for `package`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The package id.
- `name` (String) The package name.


<a id="nestedatt--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Read-Only:

- `api_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the account is entitled to use the API at all.
- `limit` (Number) The tightest-binding window's allowance, or null when nothing is metered.
- `remaining` (Number) Calls left in the current window.
- `reset_at` (Number) When the window resets, in Unix seconds.
- `scopes` (List of String) The scope vocabulary a token may be minted with.
- `token_cap` (Number) The calling token's own self-cap, when it was minted with one.
- `used` (Number) Calls spent in the current window.
